parameters.query:
SELECT
    consultation_id,
    symptom_id,
    evidence,
    certainty
FROM public.consultation_symptoms
WHERE consultation_id = $1
ORDER BY symptom_id;

SELECT json_agg(
    json_build_object(
        'symptom_id', cs.symptom_id,
        'symptom', s.name,
        'evidence', cs.evidence,
        'certainty', cs.certainty
    )
    ORDER BY cs.symptom_id
) AS symptoms
FROM public.consultation_symptoms cs
JOIN public.symptoms s
    ON s.id = cs.symptom_id
WHERE cs.consultation_id = '{{ $json.consultation_id }}';

SELECT json_agg(
    json_build_object(
        'disease_id', cdm.disease_id,
        'disease', d.name,
        'matching_symptoms', cdm.matching_symptoms,
        'matched_symptoms', cdm.matched_symptoms
    )
    ORDER BY cdm.matching_symptoms DESC, cdm.disease_id
) AS disease_matches
FROM public.consultation_disease_matches cdm
JOIN public.diseases d
    ON d.id = cdm.disease_id
WHERE cdm.consultation_id = '{{ $json.consultation_id }}';

SELECT
    pc.consultation_id,
    pc.patient_id,
    pc.consultation_date,
    pc.language,
    pc.transcript,
    pc.chief_complaint,
    pc.duration,
    pc.severity,
    pc.relevant_history,
    pc.clinical_summary,
    pc.emergency,
    pc.urgency,
    pc.red_flags,
    pc.emergency_reason,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT json_agg(
                json_build_object(
                    'symptom_id', cs.symptom_id,
                    'symptom', s.name,
                    'evidence', cs.evidence,
                    'certainty', cs.certainty
                )
                ORDER BY cs.symptom_id
            )
            FROM public.consultation_symptoms cs
            JOIN public.symptoms s
                ON s.id = cs.symptom_id
            WHERE cs.consultation_id = pc.consultation_id
        ),
        '[]'::json
    ) AS symptoms,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT json_agg(
                json_build_object(
                    'disease_id', cdm.disease_id,
                    'disease', d.name,
                    'matching_symptoms', cdm.matching_symptoms,
                    'matched_symptoms', cdm.matched_symptoms
                )
                ORDER BY cdm.matching_symptoms DESC, cdm.disease_id
            )
            FROM public.consultation_disease_matches cdm
            JOIN public.diseases d
                ON d.id = cdm.disease_id
            WHERE cdm.consultation_id = pc.consultation_id
        ),
        '[]'::json
    ) AS disease_matches

FROM public.patient_consultations pc
WHERE pc.consultation_id = $1;
